home.title: Playful Art Workshop
home.description: Create abstract paintings with fun techniques like pouring, spinning, and boxing. No artistic skills needed! Perfect for individuals, couples, and groups.
home.subtitle: For families, couples, groups of friends and teams
home.what_we_offer_intro: We offer two super fun activities, each with a different dynamic: Splash and Pouring. Choose the one that best matches your mood.
home.formats_pricing_note: Our activities are priced by canvases, not by the number of people. It's more flexible and affordable: decide whether to create one shared artwork together or let everyone paint their own.
home.activity_splash_title: Splash: paint by throwing, hitting, and playing
home.activity_splash_description: Splash is our most dynamic and energetic experience: paint with balloons, guns, balls and more using acrylic paint. No need to know how to paint; you come to let go of control, laugh, and create an abstract artwork.
home.activity_splash_details: 1.5h | 👥 Max. 6 people | Adults, kids 6+ with adults | From 17€ per person
home.activity_splash_format_big_title: One large canvas for the whole group
home.activity_splash_format_big_description: Come as a couple, with family, friends or as a team and share one 60x90 cm canvas between 2 and 6 people. It's the most fun, collaborative, and affordable format!
home.activity_splash_format_standard_descript: Come as a couple, with family, friends or as a team and choose one 30×40 cm canvas per person. The ideal option if everyone wants to take home their own artwork.
home.activity_splash_format_team_title: One or several canvases for group painting
home.activity_splash_format_team_description: Come as a couple, with a friend or as a family and create one artwork together. If you're a group of 4 to 6, choose 2 or 3 canvases to split into pairs and keep the collaborative dynamic.
home.activity_splash_format_team_note: We can also paint several standard canvases as a team: the group splits into pairs or mini-teams and paints several 30 × 40 cm canvases.
home.activity_splash_formats:
• One large canvas for the whole group
    A 60 × 90 cm canvas to paint all together. It is the most fun, collaborative, and affordable format. It works very well for couples, families, groups of friends, and teams because everyone contributes to one shared artwork.
  • One standard canvas per person
    Each participant paints their own 30 × 40 cm canvas. Ideal if everyone wants to take home an individual artwork.
  • Several standard canvases for team painting
    The group splits into pairs or mini-teams and paints several 30 × 40 cm canvases.
home.activity_pouring_title: Pouring: pour, spin, and let color flow
home.activity_pouring_description: A calmer, hypnotic experience: pour acrylic paint, move the canvas, spin it on the rotating table, and let the colors create organic patterns. Perfect for enjoying the process calmly.
home.activity_pouring_details: 1.5h | 👥 Max. 6 people | Adults, kids 6+ with adults | From 17€ per person
home.activity_pouring_format_standard_descrip: Come as a couple, with family, friends or as a team and choose one 30×40 cm canvas per person. The ideal option if everyone wants to take home their own artwork.
home.activity_pouring_format_team_title: One or several canvases for group painting
home.activity_pouring_format_team_description: Come as a couple, with a friend or as a family and create one artwork together. If you're a group of 4 to 6, choose 2 or 3 canvases to split into pairs and keep the collaborative dynamic.
home.activity_pouring_formats:
• One standard canvas per person
    Each participant paints their own 30 × 40 cm canvas and takes home an individual artwork.
  • Several standard canvases for team painting
    The group splits into pairs or mini-teams and paints several 30 × 40 cm canvases.
  • Note
    The large 60 × 90 cm canvas is available only for Splash; in Pouring we work with standard canvases.
home.activity_1_description: Dive into an unforgettable painting experience where fun meets creativity. Choose between two approaches—pouring & spinning techniques, or gloves, drips, spray, and playful tools like balloons and tennis balls—to create a vibrant abstract artwork. This activity is priced by canvases, not by the number of people. It's more flexible and affordable: decide whether to create one shared artwork together or let each member of your group paint their own!
home.activity_1_details: 1.5h | 👥 Max. 6 people | Adults, kids 6+ with adults | From 17€ per person
home.activity_1_included: Canvases, all paints & materials, protective gear, welcome drinks, personal guidance and a studio space exclusively for your group, optional photos/videos via WhatsApp.
home.activity_1_drying_note: We recommend leaving your painting in the studio for 24–48 hours to dry completely and picking it up another day. If you prefer, you can also take it with you right after the session.
home.common_takeaway_text: You'll take home a meaningful keepsake that will always have special value: not a bought artwork, but something you created yourselves — a unique, elegant piece that, thanks to its abstract style, will look great at home.
home.activity_1_outcome: Step-by-step guidance, encouragement to experiment freely. Fun, playful engagement—like being a kid again. Digital memories and a tangible art piece for your home.
home.activity_2_description: Let loose, get messy, and unleash your inner child! Throw paint, shoot it from fun guns, and burst colorful balloons against the walls. The focus is pure joy and chaos, with the option to take home a small canvas as a memory.
home.activity_2_details: 45 min | 👥 Max. 6 people | Adults, kids 5+ with adults | From 30€ per person
home.activity_2_included: Canvases, all paints & materials, protective gear, welcome drinks, personal guidance and a studio space exclusively for your group, optional photos/videos via WhatsApp.
home.activity_2_outcome: Short instructions, guidance on using materials safely. Pure emotional release, laughter, and excitement. Memorable moments captured digitally.
home.activity_3_description: Transform plain clothing into unique wearable art! Using abstract painting techniques—drips, sprays, balls—customize T-shirts, shirts, or any clothing item. Protective suits keep things safe while you experiment; you can even paint over each other for extra fun. The clothes stay vibrant after many washes—verified from personal experience, painted pieces last for years.
home.activity_3_details: 1.5h | 👥 Max. 6 people | Adults, kids 6+ with adults | From 30€ per person
home.activity_3_included: All paints & materials, protective gear, welcome drinks, personal guidance and a studio space exclusively for your group, optional photos/videos via WhatsApp.
home.activity_3_outcome: Step-by-step instructions, encouragement to experiment freely. Satisfaction from creating a unique, wearable art piece. Digital memories and an extraordinary keepsake.

main.faq_more_questions: Still have questions? Message us on WhatsApp.
main.faq_q_skills: Do you need to know how to paint?
main.faq_a_skills: No. SplashPlay isn't an art class — you come to play with paint and create without fear. We'll guide you throughout the session.
main.faq_q_private: Is the session private, or will there be other people?
main.faq_a_private: Every session is private: the studio is reserved for your group only, with no one else there.
main.faq_q_kids: How old do children need to be?
main.faq_a_kids: These sessions are about creating together as a family — kids paint alongside their parents or relatives. We recommend age 6+, though children from 4 are welcome too. Younger than 4 is not allowed.
main.faq_q_kids_groups: Do you host kids' birthday parties or children-only groups?
main.faq_a_kids_groups: That's not our focus. If it still works for you, message us on WhatsApp: up to 8 people, with children aged 8+. Tell us your group size, ages, and preferred dates, and we'll send you all the details and a quote.
main.faq_q_clothes: Is there a risk of getting paint on your clothes? What should you wear?
main.faq_a_clothes: We provide a protective suit, gloves, and shoe covers. Even so, we recommend wearing clothes you don't mind getting stained, or bringing a change of clothes — you can get changed at the studio. There's always a risk of paint getting on you, for example when taking off the suit after the session, and acrylic paint is very hard to wash out — or may not come out at all.
main.faq_q_pickup: When can paintings be collected? Can they be taken home the same day?
main.faq_a_pickup: We recommend leaving it at the studio to dry for 24–48 hours and collecting it another day. If you prefer, you can take it with you at the end of the session, though it will still be wet.
main.faq_q_cancel: Can the date be changed or the booking cancelled?
main.faq_a_cancel: You can change the date or time up to 24 hours before the session, using the confirmation email or WhatsApp. With less than 24 hours' notice, changes aren't possible: the booking is forfeited and non-refundable.
main.faq_a_discount: Yes. Many weekday time slots have discounts of up to 15–20%, depending on the season. The exact discount and final price are shown when you open the booking form. Public holidays have no discount.
main.faq_q_languages: What languages are sessions offered in?
main.faq_a_languages: It depends on who's leading the session. In general, we can run sessions in Catalan, Spanish, English, or French. If a specific language matters to you, please message us on WhatsApp to confirm.
main.faq_q_location: Where is the studio and how do you get there?
main.faq_a_location: We're at Concili de Trento, 7, El Clot (Barcelona). Metro: El Clot (L1, L2) and Glòries (L1). You'll find the map below in Contact.
main.faq_q_group: What if the group is more than 6 people?
main.faq_a_group: Regular sessions are for up to 6 people. For groups of 7–10, check out our team building page or message us on WhatsApp.
main.faq_a_gift: It's a digital PDF, not a physical card — you can print it yourself. Valid for 6 months. Buy it online and send it by email. The file includes a code; the recipient can book a session on our website by entering the code in the booking form, or message us on WhatsApp.
main.faq_q_corp_book: How do you book a team building session?
main.faq_a_corp_book: There's no online booking form. Message us on WhatsApp with your group size, preferred dates, and format (Splash, Pouring, or Team Building Special). We'll send you all the details and a quote.
main.faq_a_corp_size: For teams of 4 to 10 people. Up to 6: Splash or Pouring (1.5 h). From 6 to 10: Team Building Special (2–2.5 h).
main.faq_q_corp_invoice: Does the price include VAT? Do you issue invoices?
main.faq_a_corp_invoice: Prices are per person + VAT. Send us your company details at least 3 days in advance; we'll issue an invoice and, once payment is confirmed, your booking is confirmed. Full payment (100%) is due by card or bank transfer.
main.faq_q_corp_formats: What's the difference between Splash, Pouring, and the Team Building Special?
main.faq_a_corp_formats: Splash and Pouring last 1.5 h and are for up to 6 people: Splash is more dynamic, Pouring is calmer. The Team Building Special is for 6–10 people and lasts 2–2.5 h: canvases and tools rotate, each artwork is a group creation, and everyone takes home a painting.

corporate.hero_subtitle:
Looking for a unique activity in Barcelona to do with your team? An alternative to bowling, laser tag, art and wine, karaoke or escape rooms?

At SplashPlay, a private and fun session awaits you at our studio in El Clot. It's not a traditional art class: here you will throw paint and use unexpected techniques, creating unique memories together.

✅ For groups from 4 to 10 people

No skills needed!

corporate.activity_teambuilding_description: Your team will enjoy a playful and collaborative activity designed to spark creativity, connection, and lots of fun — no artistic skills required! There is an equal number of tools, people, and canvases. At the beginning, each participant draws a random tool — it could be a brush, sponge, roller, straw, or even something unexpected, like a ball or water gun. Everyone paints for 5 minutes using their assigned tool. Then canvases rotate clockwise, and tools rotate counterclockwise. In the end, each person will have tried every tool, and every artwork becomes a collective creation touched by everyone's style and energy!
corporate.activity_teambuilding_included: Canvases, all paints & materials, protective gear, welcome drinks, personal guidance and a studio space exclusively for your group, optional photos/videos via WhatsApp. Paintings ready after 24–48 hours.
corporate.howitworks_toggle: Team building special: view full program
corporate.howitworks_content:
🕒 DATE & TIME: Contact us to book a convenient day and time for the session. The duration is about 2–2.5 hours.

🧤 WHAT TO WEAR: We provide protective suits and shoe covers, but we still recommend wearing clothes you don't mind getting paint on — or bringing an outfit to change into.

🥤 WELCOME & INTRO: Upon arrival, each participant receives a welcome drink. We'll briefly explain the session, the materials, and how it all works.

Your creative challenge program

🙋‍♀️ There is an equal number of tools, people, and canvases.
🔨 At the beginning, each participant draws a random tool — it could be a brush, sponge, roller, straw, or even something unexpected, like a ball or water gun.
⏲️ Everyone paints for 5 minutes using their assigned tool.

Then the magic begins

🕰️ Canvases rotate clockwise, and tools rotate counterclockwise. In the end, each person will have tried every tool, and every artwork becomes a collective creation touched by everyone's style and energy.

After the rotations

🖌️ Each participant will have 5 final minutes to add finishing touches with any tool they like.
Then each participant draws a number and receives one of the paintings as a keepsake. If they wish, they can swap artworks with another teammate — because sometimes you fall in love with someone else's piece.

To close the experience

📷 We take photos of all the paintings and upload them to AI to generate fun and unexpected interpretations. Then we read them aloud — a playful and inspiring way to end the session, full of laughter and meaning.

🖼️ THE FINAL RESULT: At the end, each participant takes home one artwork created together with their team. Paintings can be picked up after 24–48 hours, once they're fully dry.

We look forward to welcoming your team to this colourful experience!
